chest_vows.book.silence.main: The Fallen Eye of the Abyss
chest_vows.book.silence.text:
The fallen abyss can never be eradicated.
It will never yield...

If you swear this vow, the Mother of Evil's corruption shall cease.
But the price is severing all ties with her,
leaving you unable to receive her boons.

"Such is the eternal price."
chest_vows.book.mutual_support.text:
The Mark of the Mother of Evil cannot be erased.
This is her curse.

If you swear this vow, shields increase with healing.
But this effect demands a great sacrifice of health and armor.

"Who, truly, is the Mother of Evil?"
chest_vows.book.trauma.text:
This pain shall be eternal.
For all ages, forever unending...

If you swear this vow, damage taken will be returned over time,
and incoming damage is capped.
The cost is reduced healing effectiveness.

"Carry this torment into reincarnation... fight for hatred for all eternity."
chest_vows.book.ctrl_magic.text:
The existence of this arcane power
is the variable...

Magic damage is increased and physical damage is converted,
but you become highly vulnerable to magic and piercing damage.

"This game... has no solution."
chest_vows.book.pain_soul.text:
Obey and prosper; defy and perish.

Shields increase with maximum health,
but health is reduced and shields decrease alongside your health cap.

"The blood rain has fallen. His era... is over."
chest_vows.book.abandon.text:
One day you wiped out my entire clan.
Today I shall tear you to pieces!

If you swear this vow, every attack applies the Mother of Evil's curse.
But a portion of your own life must be sacrificed to her.

"O Mother of Evil, grant me power...."
chest_vows.book.blood_sacrifice.text:
Drink the blood of the heavens and attain immortality.
Scar Tissue is greatly enhanced and absorbs all damage,
but its cooldown is significantly longer after being eradicated.

"The sacrifice is made. There is no turning back."
chest_vows.book.sword_holder.text:
Those who defy heaven's will shall be slain!

Attacks with a sword may trigger multi-hit combos and have a higher chance to sweep.
After swearing this vow, damage dealt with non-sword weapons is reduced.

"I am no demon. I am simply unyielding."
chest_vows.book.blood_army.main: The Blood Legion of Broken Hope
chest_vows.book.blood_army.text:
Only attack, never defend. To defend is to cease being the Blood Legion.

Health regeneration is greatly increased, with natural recovery every two seconds.
After swearing this vow, taking any damage prevents healing for five seconds
before recovery can resume.

"I want to live."
chest_vows.book.symbiosis.text:
Four aspects, four invasions—shatter the shackles of causality.

While Scar Marks recover, the other four shields also recover.
Scar Marks regenerate only over time and no longer absorb other shields' recovery.
Recovery time for shields other than Scar Marks is extended.
chest_vows.book.chief_priest.text:
Born toward death, cursed by causality.

Health and resistances are significantly increased,
but there is a small chance for incoming damage to double
and a small chance for healing to fail entirely.

"Undeath is stagnation. That is good... that is good."
chest_vows.vow.weighty_wind: Roar—the roar that tears through the heavens

chest_vows.book.weighty_wind.text:
A hurricane roaring against injustice.

After swearing this vow, you cannot be knocked back while moving,
but your movement speed is fixed.
chest_vows.vow.inner_demon: This heart brims with endless arcane power
item.chest_vows.inner_demon.1: Maximum health gradually increases with each creature killed
item.chest_vows.inner_demon.2: Each heal can restore at most %d health
chest_vows.book.inner_demon.text:
The Inner Demon takes form—it is your dark side.

After swearing this vow, your health grows with each kill,
but each heal is capped at a fixed amount.

"Either be controlled by the Inner Demon,
or merge with it...."
